messages:
Maria G: quick sync — heads up, packaging hiccup on the python sdk. pip install works locally but poetry install resolves an older httpx that breaks streaming. anyone else seen this?
Ajay P: yep saw similar yesterday. poetry.lock pinned httpx 0.22 in one of the examples. did you try updating the lockfile?
Maria G: I tried poetry update httpx but then other deps (aiohttp-compat) complained. repro steps: python3.10, poetry 1.4.2, run `poetry install` then `pytest tests/streaming_test.py` -> stream chunks stop after a few tokens.
Tess L: do we have a minimal repro? can you paste the exact error/trace?
Maria G: it's noisy, but main symptom is: `ConnectionResetError: Cannot read from transport` inside httpx._content.StreamingResponse.__anext__
Ryan K: could be our retry middleware interacting with httpx async iterators. We wrap streaming in a RetrySession that reuses the iterator — that breaks when connection resets mid-stream.
Chloe M: we added that middleware to handle flaky infra, but it wasn't originally async-aware. Maybe poetry pulled in an httpx with iterator semantics changed.
Ajay P: suggestion: for streaming, treat the response iterator as single-use and don't retry across it. I can open a quick PR to make retry bail if `stream=True`.
Maria G: that would help. Also typing issue: consumers using `from redwood import AsyncClient` get mypy errors because AsyncClient is an alias in __init__.py. Should we export proper types in py.typed?
Tess L: yes, export types and include `__all__` with the Typed classes. We should also add a simple stub `types.pyi` for the alias edge-case.
Ryan K: back to poetry — intermediate fix: pin httpx>=0.23,<0.25 in pyproject for now and add a note in changelog. Longer term: support both httpx and aiohttp backends?
Maria G: pin sounds good for patch release. Ajay, PR for retry fix + test? Tess, can you handle the typing stubs? Ryan, can you add the lockfile change + release note?
Ajay P: on it. I'll add a test that simulates connection reset mid-stream and asserts we don't attempt to re-iterate the same generator. PR in a few hours.
Tess L: I'll add a `py.typed` and a small pyi for AsyncClient and update docs for typing.
Ryan K: I'll update pyproject and lockfile, push a patch branch `patch/poetry-httpx-pin` and draft the release note.
Maria G: thanks. CI note — ci-bot: please run the matrix with poetry 1.4 and 1.5, python 3.10/3.11, httpx 0.23/0.24 combos so we can verify.
ci-bot: running workflow "python-sdk-tests" with matrix: poetry:[1.4.2,1.5.0], python:[3.10,3.11], httpx:[0.23.3,0.24.0]. I'll post results. :robot_face:
Chloe M: tiny ask — add a comment in sdk README about streaming semantics + retries so integrators don't wrap streams incorrectly.
Maria G: good call. I'll open a follow-up doc PR once the patch lands.
Ajay P: one more: should we deprecate our retry-by-default behavior for hosted customers, and instead expose a configurable retry policy? leads to fewer surprises.
Tess L: yeah, make retries opt-in for streaming endpoints, default on non-streaming. We'll document that.
Maria G: solid. thanks everyone, ping me if you hit blockers.
Ryan K: will do — tagging @chloe for README commit review. :thumbsup:
Chloe M: on it.
ci-bot: workflow complete — all matrix runs passed except poetry 1.5 / httpx 0.24 combo which failed the streaming test (repro confirmed). CI links: https://ci.example.com/build/17812 :white_check_mark:
